ko.Metal HUD displays performance counters;: Metal HUD는 성능 지표를 표시하며 게임 성능을 향상시키지는 않습니다.

ko.The original launch command overrides CP: 기존 실행 명령은 CPU, 메모리, Vulkan 설정을 덮어씁니다. 저장 값의 사용은 보장되지 않습니다.
ko.Configuration operation failed. Reload t: 설정 작업 실패. 설정을 다시 읽고 FX 중지를 확인하세요.
ko.A verified backup is required before wri: 쓰기 전에 검증된 백업이 필요합니다. 외부 변경 감지 시 중지합니다.
ko.FX is running. Stop FX yourself before s: FX 실행 중. 저장 전에 직접 중지하세요.
ko.This FX version or build is not supporte: 이 FX 버전 또는 빌드는 편집을 지원하지 않습니다.
ko.A parameter is unsupported or outside th: 지원하지 않는 매개변수이거나 허용 범위를 벗어났습니다.
ko.Select an existing launcher directory in: 먼저 FX 관리자에서 기존 런처 폴더를 선택하세요.
ko.Custom values may be rejected by the ori: 사용자 설정 값은 기존 게임 실행 사전 검사에서 거부될 수 있습니다. 해당 경로 사용 전에 백업을 복원하세요.

ru.Super resolution is read-only until Meta: Суперразрешение доступно только для чтения до проверки поддержки MetalFX.

ru.Save while FX is stopped. Restart FX and: Сохраняйте при остановленном FX. Настройки загрузятся после перезапуска FX и гостя. Автоперезапуска нет.
ru.The original launch command overrides CP: Исходная команда запуска переопределяет ЦП, память и Vulkan. Сохранённые значения могут не использоваться.
ru.Restored; runtime adoption unverified: Восстановлено; применение в ВМ не проверено
ru.Saved; runtime adoption unverified: Сохранено; применение в ВМ не проверено
ru.Configuration operation failed. Reload t: Операция не удалась. Перечитайте настройки и убедитесь, что FX остановлен.
ru.No valid backup or configuration has cha: Нет действительной копии или настройки изменены
ru.A verified backup is required before wri: Перед записью нужна проверенная копия. Внешние изменения останавливают операцию.
ru.FX is running. Stop FX yourself before s: FX работает. Остановите его вручную перед сохранением.
ru.This FX version or build is not supporte: Эта версия или сборка FX не поддерживает редактирование.
ru.The backup is unavailable or invalid. No: Копия недоступна или повреждена. Восстановление не выполнено.
ru.A parameter is unsupported or outside th: Параметр не поддерживается или вне допустимого диапазона.
ru.Select an existing launcher directory in: Сначала выберите каталог лаунчера в управлении FX.
ru.Custom values may be rejected by the ori: Собственные значения могут не пройти исходную проверку запуска игры. Восстановите копию перед таким запуском.

es.Changing Vulkan drivers may rebuild shad: Cambiar el controlador Vulkan puede reconstruir cachés de sombreadores y afectar la compatibilidad.
es.Metal HUD displays performance counters;: Metal HUD muestra métricas; no mejora el rendimiento del juego.
es.Save while FX is stopped. Restart FX and: Guarde con FX detenido. Reinicie FX y Guest para cargar los ajustes. Sin reinicio automático.

es.No verified performance recommendation i: No hay recomendaciones de rendimiento verificadas.

es.Saved; runtime adoption unverified: Guardado; uso en ejecución sin verificar

es.Read the configuration and edit paramete: Primero lea la configuración y edite parámetros
es.No valid backup or configuration has cha: Sin copia válida o configuración modificada
es.A verified backup is required before wri: Se requiere una copia verificada antes de escribir. Los cambios externos detienen la operación.
es.FX is running. Stop FX yourself before s: FX está en ejecución. Deténgalo antes de guardar.
es.This FX version or build is not supporte: Esta versión o compilación de FX no admite edición.

fr.Saved; runtime adoption unverified: Enregistré ; application en exécution non vérifiée

zh-TW.Super resolution is read-only until Meta: 確認裝置支援 MetalFX 前，超解析度保持唯讀。

zh-TW.No verified performance recommendation i: 暫無經過驗證的效能建議。
zh-TW.Restored; runtime adoption unverified: 還原成功；執行中是否採用仍未驗證
zh-TW.Saved; runtime adoption unverified: 已寫入；執行中是否採用仍未驗證

zh-TW.A verified backup is required before wri: 寫入前必須建立並驗證備份。偵測到外部修改會停止操作。
zh-TW.FX is running. Stop FX yourself before s: FX 正在執行，請自行停止 FX 後再儲存。
zh-TW.Configuration changed externally. Reload: 配置已被其他程式修改，請重新讀取。
zh-TW.This FX version or build is not supporte: 此 FX 版本或組建尚不支援編輯。
zh-TW.The backup is unavailable or invalid. No: 備份無法使用或無效，未執行還原。
zh-TW.A parameter is unsupported or outside th: 參數不受支援或超出允許範圍。
zh-TW.Select an existing launcher directory in: 請先在 FX 管理中選擇既有啟動器目錄。
zh-TW.Custom values may be rejected by the ori: 自訂值可能被原遊戲啟動預檢拒絕。使用原啟動路徑前請還原備份。

en.Super resolution is read-only until Meta: Super resolution is read-only until MetalFX device support is verified.
en.CPU and memory share host resources. Nat: CPU and memory share host resources. Native limits reserve memory for macOS and the GPU.
en.Changing Vulkan drivers may rebuild shad: Changing Vulkan drivers may rebuild shader caches and affect compatibility.
en.Metal HUD displays performance counters;: Metal HUD displays performance counters; it does not improve game performance.
en.Save while FX is stopped. Restart FX and: Save while FX is stopped. Restart FX and Guest to load saved settings. No automatic restart.
en.The original launch command overrides CP: The original launch command overrides CPU, memory and Vulkan settings. Saved values are not guaranteed to be used.
en.No verified performance recommendation i: No verified performance recommendation is available.
en.Configuration operation failed. Reload t: Configuration operation failed. Reload the configuration and check FX is stopped.
en.Read the configuration and edit paramete: Read the configuration and edit parameters first
en.No valid backup or configuration has cha: No valid backup or configuration has changed
en.A verified backup is required before wri: A verified backup is required before writing. External changes stop the operation.
en.FX is running. Stop FX yourself before s: FX is running. Stop FX yourself before saving.
en.Configuration changed externally. Reload: Configuration changed externally. Reload before continuing.
en.This FX version or build is not supporte: This FX version or build is not supported for editing.
en.The backup is unavailable or invalid. No: The backup is unavailable or invalid. No restore was performed.
en.A parameter is unsupported or outside th: A parameter is unsupported or outside the allowed range.
en.Select an existing launcher directory in: Select an existing launcher directory in FX Manager first.
en.Custom values may be rejected by the ori: Custom values may be rejected by the original game launch preflight. Restore the backup before using that launch path.

zh-CN.Super resolution is read-only until Meta: 确认设备支持 MetalFX 前，超分辨率保持只读。

zh-CN.Saved; runtime adoption unverified: 已写入；运行中是否采用仍未验证
zh-CN.Configuration operation failed. Reload t: 配置操作失败。请重新读取配置并确认 FX 已停止。
zh-CN.Read the configuration and edit paramete: 请先读取配置并编辑参数
zh-CN.No valid backup or configuration has cha: 没有有效备份，或配置已发生变化
zh-CN.A verified backup is required before wri: 写入前必须创建并验证备份。检测到外部修改会停止操作。

zh-CN.Configuration changed externally. Reload: 配置已被其他程序修改，请重新读取。
zh-CN.This FX version or build is not supporte: 此 FX 版本或构建尚不支持编辑。
